_comment: Subsistema E smoke — Google Sheets. The agent creates a spreadsheet, adds a tab, seeds 5 numbers, writes a SUM formula, reads back both evaluated value and formula text. Requires GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS env. Run: `set -a; source .env; set +a; cargo run --bin dag_engine -- run tests/graphs/agents/gsheets_smoke.json --agent-session-id e_smoke_$(date +%s) --include-extra-info`

test_payload.prompt:
Run a Google Sheets smoke. Use ONLY these exact tool names (with the gsheets_ prefix):

1. Call gsheets_create_spreadsheet({title: 'Colmena E Smoke <UTC timestamp>'}). Capture spreadsheet_id and url from the response.
2. Call gsheets_add_sheet({spreadsheet_id, name: 'Numbers'}).
3. Call gsheets_set_range({spreadsheet_id, sheet: 'Numbers', start_addr: 'A1', values_2d: [[10],[20],[30],[40],[50]]}).
4. Call gsheets_set_cell({spreadsheet_id, sheet: 'Numbers', addr: 'B1', value: '=SUM(A1:A5)'}).
5. Call gsheets_read({spreadsheet_id, sheet: 'Numbers', range: 'B1', value_render: 'UNFORMATTED_VALUE'}). Confirm the value is 150.
6. Call gsheets_read({spreadsheet_id, sheet: 'Numbers', range: 'B1', value_render: 'FORMULA'}). Confirm the value is '=SUM(A1:A5)'.
7. Final report (under 200 words): the spreadsheet url + the value/formula you read.

config.system_message: You are an assistant exercising the Google Sheets tool surface. Use ONLY the exact tool names provided in your tool schemas (they all start with gsheets_). Do NOT invent tool names or drop the prefix. Report what you observed at each step (cell counts, formula text, evaluated values).
